description: S3-3HDM scalar parameter points surviving boundedness-from-below ([DasDey14] Eq.4 PLUS the corrected neutral condition derived in notebook section 5, PLUS a full 12-dimensional numerical backstop), tree unitarity [DasDey14] Eq.36-37, no tachyons, m_Hpm > 80 GeV, and one CP-even state at 125 +- 3 GeV (a MASS condition only).  hvv_squared gives each CP-even state's hVV coupling^2 in units of the SM's (h0 is exactly 0; H1+H2 sum to 1), so a coupling-aware neutral cut is a column filter.  CAVEAT: none is applied here, so some points carry a light H1/H2 or put the 125 GeV mass on a state with little hVV coupling; a light h0 is safe because it is gauge-phobic.
